title: Gillespie's September 1947 Carnegie Hall concert
summary: He confirms the Afro Drums Suite concert was the first one he was asked to do.

blocks.x: Okay, first question. I was at the Lincoln Center Library yesterday, and I discovered mention of a concert that I've not known about, by Dizzy Gillespie, September 29, '47 at Carnegie Hall. And he apparently played a thing called Afro Drums Suite. That was in September, before the Town Hall. Do you know anything about that?
Yeah. They couldn't carry it in Carnegie Hall.
No, no, no, it was Carnegie Hall.
In September. That was -- when he asked me, that's what (unintelligible).
And the second one, Chickie was there.
So it was the September Carnegie Hall.
